summary: GEE Group Inc. (NYSE American: JOB) filed an Item 8.01 8-K on September 28, 2026, disclosing that its Audit Committee recently learned of a previously undisclosed April 27, 2023 Executive Employment Agreement with Allison Dewan, Vice President of Corporate Development and daughter of Chairman/CEO Derek Dewan. The agreement provides a five-year term ending April 26, 2028, an initial $110,000 base salary, bonuses, equity eligibility, perquisites, and severance/change-of-control terms comparable to executives. The Audit Committee is conducting an independent inquiry into origin, authorization, disclosure controls, and related-party disclosure thresholds. This is an internal governance/disclosure matter, not a special situation; monitor inquiry findings and any restatement or control-remediation risk.
